Sound samples: Kenney, CC0 1.0.
https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Adaptations: trimmed leading silence and long tails, normalized peak level, applied short fades, converted to mono PCM WAV.
The original drum kit is synthesized in the game.

Tutorial samples: user-provided 【BeatStream】Tutorial チュートリアル Arcade 20170831_720p60.mp4.
Distinct Beat, Ripple, Slash, Long start and Long completion recording excerpts.
Both conservative background-reduction and raw-recording short cuts are included.
These are microphone recording excerpts, not isolated official game sound assets.
See tutorial-source.json for timestamps and tools/tutorial/extract_sfx.py for reproducible processing.

Rhythm / Pulse / Heavy kits: original deterministic percussion synthesis and short remixed attack layers from the bundled Kenney CC0 samples.
No tutorial recording, voice, background music, reverb or melodic chord is used in these kits.
15 sounds, 48 kHz mono PCM16, 1 ms attack / 9 ms tail fades, peak 0.78.
See rhythm-source.json and tools/build-rhythm-sfx.py for the source layers and reproducible synthesis.
